test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

This app is a very ______ one for online shopping.
solution: The correct answer is '**convenient**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**convenient**'. • It means 'suitable or practical for a particular purpose; not causing difficulty'. (विशेष उद्देश्‍य की दृष्टि से उपयुक्त या व्‍यावहारिक; आसान, सुविधाजनक) • *Example: I’m willing to meet you on any day that’s **convenient** for you.* • Thus, the correct answer is** Option 3.** **Correct Sentence:__** *This app is a very **convenient** one for online shopping.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **convenience**: the quality of being easy, useful, or suitable for somebody. (आसानी, सुविधा, उपयुक्तता) • **competency**: the fact of having the ability or skill that is needed for something. (कुछ करने की क्षमता, विशिष्‍ट योग्‍यता सामर्थ्य, सक्षमता) • **capable**: having the ability or qualities necessary to do something. (कुछ करने में सक्षम या समर्थ) 14a:Tc0e, The correct answer is **'No improvement required'.**
